en.title: AWS Introduces Lambda Web Functions for Node.js Applications
en.summary: AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions, allowing developers to run Node.js web applications using frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and response streaming. Lambda Web Functions currently support only Node.js, while other languages remain available through traditional Lambda functions, and the service is currently available in five regions.

claims.text: AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions, allowing developers to run Node.js web applications using frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and response streaming.

evidence.quote: AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions , allowing developers to run Node.js web applications using frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and response streaming.

claims.text: Lambda Web Functions currently support only Node.js, while other languages remain available through traditional Lambda functions, and the service is currently available in five regions.

evidence.quote: Lambda Web Functions currently support only Node.js; other languages, including Python, Java, and .NET, remain available through traditional Lambda functions.
The service is currently available in five regions: Northern Virginia, Ohio, Oregon, Tokyo, and Ireland.
Today, Lambda Web Functions supports the Node.js runtime.

en.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
en.summary: Cloudflare launched a post-quantum geographically restricted key manager in closed beta to support its Data Localization Suite, with general availability planned for Q1 2027. The system utilizes a hybrid ML-KEM-768 and X25519 protection scheme, combining NIST-standard post-quantum cryptography with classical components.

claims.text: Cloudflare launched a post-quantum geographically restricted key manager in closed beta to support its Data Localization Suite, with general availability planned for Q1 2027.

evidence.quote: Today, Cloudflare is launching a post-quantum geographically restricted key manager in support of our Data Localization Suite (DLS) in closed beta.
While general availability (GA) is planned for Q1 2027, today’s launch is an important milestone on our journey to support our customers’ data sovereignty goals

claims.text: The system utilizes a hybrid ML-KEM-768 and X25519 protection scheme, combining NIST-standard post-quantum cryptography with classical components.

evidence.quote: Cloudflare therefore uses hybrid ML-KEM-768 and X25519 protection with two kinds of keys, out of which ML-KEM-768 is a NIST standard that also opens doors to highly sensitive customers.
Its key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM) combines ML-KEM-768 with X25519 , while HKDF -SHA-256 provides key derivation and AES-256-GCM provides authenticated encryption.

en.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
en.summary: Cloudflare launched an edge implementation of WebMCP in beta during August to help AI agents interact with online storefronts reliably. Commerce.com uses Cloudflare to run nearly 100,000 domains and integrated WebMCP alongside its server-side Model Context Protocol. WebMCP remains an experimental browser proposal in early preview rather than a stable, broadly available browser standard.

evidence.quote: In August, we launched edge implementation of WebMCP in beta.

evidence.quote: Commerce.com , a flexible commerce platform built for the age of AI, already uses Cloudflare to run their almost 100,000 domains.
WebMCP also works side by side with our server-side MCP , and together they cover the different ways people shop with agents.

evidence.quote: WebMCP is still an experimental proposed browser standard in early preview

en.title: Google’s Data Agent Kit Reaches General Availability
en.summary: Google has generally made its Data Agent Kit available, following a preview period over the summer. The kit installs into coding agents that Google does not own and operates without extra licensing cost. With the general availability release, the company added support for BigQuery Graph, Bigtable, and Managed Service for Apache Spark.

evidence.quote: Google recently made Data Agent Kit generally available , moving it out of the preview it ran through the summer.

claims.text: The kit installs into coding agents that Google does not own and operates without extra licensing cost.

evidence.quote: It is free, it is open source, and it installs into coding agents Google does not own.
Data Agent Kit is included at no additional cost; you pay standard pricing only for the Google Cloud services your agent uses.

claims.text: With the general availability release, the company added support for BigQuery Graph, Bigtable, and Managed Service for Apache Spark.

en.title: Cloudflare Reclaims 100 TB of RAM by Optimizing Consistent Hashing
en.summary: Cloudflare reduced the memory footprint of its internal load-balancing service by more than 100 TB by optimizing consistent hashing. The team applied statistical analysis to reduce the number of hashes per backend by about 90 percent while preserving accuracy. The new implementation was rolled out gradually alongside the existing ring to limit cache churn and origin traffic spikes.

claims.text: Cloudflare reduced the memory footprint of its internal load-balancing service by more than 100 TB by optimizing consistent hashing.

evidence.quote: Cloudflare recently documented how it reduced the memory footprint of its internal load-balancing service by more than 100 TB by optimizing the Rust implementation of consistent hashing in pingora-ketama.

claims.text: The team applied statistical analysis to reduce the number of hashes per backend by about 90 percent while preserving accuracy.

evidence.quote: The changes compacted hash-ring entries and used statistical analysis of hash distribution and collision rates to reduce the number of hashes per backend by about 90% while preserving load-balancing accuracy.

claims.text: The new implementation was rolled out gradually alongside the existing ring to limit cache churn and origin traffic spikes.

evidence.quote: The new implementation was rolled out gradually alongside the existing ring to limit cache churn and origin traffic spikes.
